reason: In packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleEmailReminders.ts the pre-existing deleteMany at lines 34-41 removes every EMAIL reminder with scheduledDate <= now, whether or not it is cancelled. The patch places its cancel loop after it (lines 43-77), so a cancelled reminder whose time passed before the cron ran is deleted with no POST to /v3/user/scheduled_sends. By then SendGrid's send time has passed, so the late cron run lets the cancelled email go out.
